behaviors_asserted: The middleware's default Referrer-Policy is currently set to no-referrer.
When Referrer-Policy is no-referrer, it hides both the Referer and Origin headers (serializedOrigin becomes null).
Hiding the Origin header can weaken CSRF mitigations because the server cannot verify same-origin requests.
The default Referrer-Policy should be strict-origin-when-cross-origin to minimize information leaks while preserving Origin for same-origin requests.
